title: Rabbi Abba of Carthage
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned only in the Jerusalem Talmud. Under the latter name (Kartigenaya) he is mentioned in Demai 2:2, Kilayim 1:9 and 8:1, Taanit 2:2, Sanhedrin 7:1, and Shevuot, end of 3:1, and 7:1. Under the former name (Kartina’ah) he is mentioned in Berakhot 1:3 and Ketubot 5:1. In Shevuot, end of 3:1, Rabbi La resolves his difficulty; Hyman therefore places him approximately in the third generation of Palestinian Amoraim.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:1 names Rabbi Ba Kartigena. The notice’s Kartina’ah/Kartigenaya distribution and approximate generation remain Hyman’s account.
